# Conditions Precedent Checklist (draft)

*Generated by the firm's drafting tool from the Loan and Security Agreement draft of September 22, 2026. Not yet verified.*

## 1. Conditions to closing

(a) Executed Loan and Security Agreement and other Loan Documents (Section 3.1(a)).

(b) Secretary's certificate with charter, bylaws, resolutions and incumbency (Section 3.1(b)).

(c) Good standing certificates from Delaware and each state of qualification (Section 3.1(c)).

(d) Completed and executed Perfection Certificate (Section 3.1(d)).

(e) Lien searches and evidence of release of liens other than Permitted Liens (Section 3.1(e)).

(f) Evidence of insurance with lender's loss payable and additional insured endorsements (Section 3.1(f)).

(g) Deposit account control agreements for each deposit account (Section 3.1(g)).

(h) Subordination agreements from convertible noteholders or evidence of conversion (Section 3.1(h)).

(i) Intercreditor or subordination agreement with Vantage Equipment Finance (Section 3.1(i)).

(j) Payment of the closing fee and Bank's expenses (Section 3.1(j)).

(k) Executed Warrant (Section 3.1(k)).

(l) Opinion of Borrower's counsel (Section 3.1(l)).

## 2. Conditions to each advance

(a) Notice of borrowing (Section 3.2(a)).

(b) Representations true and correct in all material respects (Section 3.2(b)).

(c) No default continuing (Section 3.2(c)).

(d) For Tranche 1, evidence the Series C Financing has closed (Section 3.2(d)).

(e) For Tranche 2, a Compliance Certificate showing Annualized Recurring Revenue of at least $40,000,000 (Section 3.2(e)).
